name: Dianne Feinstein
role: U.S. senator from California (1992-2023); mayor of San Francisco (1978-1988)
summary: Dianne Feinstein was a Democratic senator who authored the 1994 federal assault weapons ban and chaired the Senate Intelligence Committee. Her votes were liberal on guns, abortion and marriage, and hawkish or establishment-minded on surveillance, crime and NATO.

abortion-legal.rationale: She voted against the federal partial-birth abortion bans and for the 1999 and 2003 Senate resolutions supporting Roe v. Wade.

collective-defense.rationale: She voted to ratify the NATO accession protocols for Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic in 1998 and for seven more members in 2003.

death-penalty.rationale: In 1993 she voted for a death penalty where a carjacking causes a death and against replacing the death penalty with life imprisonment.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: In 2005 she introduced a constitutional amendment for direct popular election of the President and Vice President, calling the Electoral College archaic.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: In 2021 she said the United States must take swift, decisive action to reduce carbon emissions, especially from transportation.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: She voted to ratify NATO enlargement in 1998 and 2003, joining the permanent alliance's expansion.

free-trade.rationale: Her record splits: she voted against NAFTA in 1993 but for the Peru, Colombia and Panama agreements and the 2020 USMCA.

limit-guns.rationale: She authored the federal ban on semiautomatic military combat weapons (Britannica) and voted for the Brady handgun background-check bill and the 2004 gun-show background checks.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: On the Senate floor in 2014 she said the $7.25 federal minimum wage fails to provide a living wage for many Americans and called for a raise.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: She voted against the 1996 Defense of Marriage Act and for its 2022 repeal.

surveillance-ok.rationale: She voted for the 2006 USA PATRIOT reauthorization and the 2012 five-year extension of the FISA Amendments Act.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: She described her encryption bill as one requiring all companies to abide by lawful court orders.

work-for-welfare.rationale: She voted for the 1996 amendment requiring welfare recipients to take part in gainful community service (99-0).
